SECTION D: (5 Marks Each)

Q32(A). A motor boat whose speed is 18 km/h in still water takes 1 hour more to go 24 km upstream than to return downstream to the same spot. Find the speed of the stream.
OR
Q32(B). Two water taps together can fill a tank in 9 3/8 hours. The larger tap takes 10 hours less than the smaller one to fill the tank separately. Find time taken by each.

Answer / Solution (A):
Let stream speed = x km/h
Upstream speed = 18 - x, downstream speed = 18 + x
Given: 24/(18-x) - 24/(18+x) = 1
24[(18+x)-(18-x)]/(324 - x^2) = 1
24(2x) = 324 - x^2
x^2 + 48x - 324 = 0
(x + 54)(x - 6) = 0 => x = 6 (positive)
Answer: 6 km/h

Answer / Solution (B):
Together rate = 1/(9 3/8) = 1/(75/8) = 8/75
Let larger tap time = x hours, smaller = x + 10
1/x + 1/(x+10) = 8/75
75(2x+10) = 8(x^2 + 10x)
150x + 750 = 8x^2 + 80x
8x^2 - 70x - 750 = 0 => 4x^2 - 35x - 375 = 0
x = (35 ± 85)/8 => x = 15 (valid)
So larger = 15 hours, smaller = 25 hours
Answer: Larger 15 h, Smaller 25 h
